summary: Liquidity Services filed an 8-K reporting entry into a merger agreement and immediate closing of its acquisition of Auction Holdings, Inc., operator of Invaluable, AuctionZip and RFC Auction Systems, online marketplaces for fine art, antiques and estate auctions. The company paid $80 million cash, funded from cash on hand, with customary working capital, cash and debt adjustments. Merger Sub merged into Auction Holdings, which survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. About $9.4 million was escrowed for indemnification and purchase-price adjustments, released at 12-month and three-year anniversaries. Key employees signed 12- or 24-month restrictive covenants; investors signed non-solicitation agreements. Arbitrage angle is limited as the deal is already closed; watch integration, escrow claims and seller earnout mechanics.
